Access service means telecommunication service provided to subscribers by means of a telecommunication system for the conveyance of voice or non-voice messages through wired or wireless telegraphy on the network of the Access Service Provider. 2. National Long Distance (NLD) service refers to the carriage of switched-bearer telecommunication services over a long distance network. 3. International Long Distance (ILD) Service is defined as a network carriage service, providing the NLD Operators in the country, International connectivity to Network facilities operated by foreign carriers in other countries 4. MNP (Mobile Number Portability) means a service which allows subscribers to retain their existing telephone number when they switch from one access service provider to another irrespective of mobile technology or from one technology to another of the same or any other access service provider 5. ISP stands for Internet Service Providers (Source – DoT License Agreement) 96 Chart 4.2: Service wise composition of Adjusted Gross Revenue for the year 2024-25 6 Access services contributed 83.65% of the total Adjusted Gross Revenue of telecom services.
